::: {.chem-source-note}
### Question-bank basis
The practice bank was independently written from concepts represented in the supplied Chapter 1–6 lecture decks. Chapter 1 is available for custom review but is excluded from the syllabus-defined Exam I preset, which covers Chapters 2–6. Deck metadata identifies John Tymoczko and *Biochemistry*, 8th edition (Macmillan Education, 2015). The Fall 2026 paper syllabus supplied by Yizhi Sun identifies Exam I coverage and lists Berg et al., *Biochemistry*, 9th edition as the textbook. No slide text, publisher figure, or official assessment item is reproduced.
